originalTitle: Will CATL's new 500 Wh/kg battery be commercially available in 2023?
title: CATL 500 Wh/kg 电池是否在 2023 年实现商业可用？
Did CATL’s 500 Wh/kg battery become commercially available in 2023?
rules: 可信来源须确认商业产品或供应渠道使用该电池，并证明达到 500+ Wh/kg；年份来自题名，正文未详细列出测试协议。
A credible source must identify a commercial product/source and proven 500+ Wh/kg. The year is in the title; the body does not define a detailed test protocol.
interpretation: 平台判定 No；保留发布、性能主张与可购买产品的区别。
The source resolved No; launch, performance claim and purchasable product remain distinct.

summary: 这道历史题同时要求商业来源与比能量验证，CATL 当年的技术公告只回答其中一部分。
This historical contract combines commercial sourcing and energy verification; the technology announcement addresses only part of that evidence.
checklist: 核对实际商品和供应渠道。
核对样品边界与 500+ Wh/kg 测试。
Verify sample boundary and 500+ Wh/kg testing.
核对证据是否在 2023 年内成立。

stage: 材料与试验 → 产品验证 → 实际应用
Materials and tests → product verification → application
impact: 企业公告提出单体高比能路线，但整包、可采购性和独立性能测试还需要产品级证据。本站不将“可快速量产”的表述写成商业交付完成，并保留原市场 No。
The announcement proposes high cell energy, while packs, procurement and verified performance need product evidence. “Can mass-produce soon” is not recorded as completed delivery, and No is retained.
gap: 技术公告不能单独建立商业可用。
A technical announcement alone does not establish commercial availability.

title: 凝聚态单体性能与可购买产品
Condensed-cell performance and purchasable products
principle: 比能量为可释放能量与样品质量之比，需给出温度、倍率与样品边界。企业称凝聚态的路线并不自动等于全固态。
Specific energy divides released energy by sample mass and needs temperature, rate and boundary information. A condensed-state label does not automatically imply all-solid-state.
example: 2023 年 500 Wh/kg 公告说明技术发布；原市场同时要求商业来源和 500+ Wh/kg 被证明。本站保留原平台 No，不把公告最高值当作商业验证。
The 2023 500 Wh/kg release is a launch. The contract also requires a commercial source and proven 500+ Wh/kg; its No outcome is retained.
